description: This file defines the Java class `LoanForeClosurePreBusinessEvent`, which is a specific type of loan business event triggered prior to loan foreclosure closure within the Apache Fineract project. It extends `LoanBusinessEvent` and is part of the loan transaction event domain, encapsulating event details related to loan foreclosure pre-processing.

classes.name: LoanForeClosurePreBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event triggered before the foreclosure of a loan, extending the core loan event functionalities and providing specific event type for pre-closure foreclosure in the loan transaction domain.

methods.name: LoanForeClosurePreBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a given Loan object, invoking the superclass constructor.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the event, which is 'LoanForeClosurePreBusinessEvent'.
